ns2:course.label: Special Media/Cinema Topics
ns2:course.description: Cultural, social, historical, economic, and/or political issues in media and/or cinema; topics vary but may include: genres, historical movements, thematic studies, television, convergence culture, new media. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours if topics vary.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, or Senior class standing.
